raw_control: Stops at ROM bad Chksm = BEh; Error. Press F1 key to continue. No F1 override used.
corrected: POST reaches 640K; boots DOS; all BIOSCHK checks pass; returns to COMMAND.COM; TYPE BIOSCHK.TXT reads back the result file.
checks: INT 10h reports mode 3 and 80 columns; teletype output visible
INT 1Ah advances at least three ticks
INT 13h reset and read boot sector with 55AA signature
INT 13h read C39 H1 S9 matches 512 bytes of A5
INT 16h physical key input returns 256Bh for lowercase k
DOS writes and closes BIOSCHK.TXT; host mtype and guest TYPE read it back
limitations: Tests cover one emulated XT configuration, not the original motherboard.
Not exhaustive coverage of every BIOS path or peripheral.
No physical EPROM programming or independent reader test performed.
reproduction_run: prepare.py produced a fresh VM and disk; independently booted and generated identical BIOSCHK.TXT.
